curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: appreciate the importance of correct use of tense in communication.

interactions.prompt: A girl is running now. Which word tells what is happening now?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Running tells us the action is happening now.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the action word ending in -ing.

interactions.prompt: Choose the clear message about what Ali is doing now.
interactions.feedback: Well said! The correct tense makes the message clear.
interactions.retryHint: Use is before the -ing action for one person.

interactions.prompt: Two children have a ball now. Complete: They are ___.
interactions.feedback: Great! They are playing tells the action clearly.
interactions.retryHint: After are, choose the action ending in -ing.

interactions.prompt: Which sentence helps a friend picture what Mother is doing right now?
Your teacher asks, “What are you doing?” Which reply is clearest?
interactions.feedback: Excellent communication! Your tense matches right now.
interactions.retryHint: For I, use am before the -ing word.

interactions.prompt: Why do we use the correct tense?
choices: It tells when an action happens clearly.
interactions.answer: It tells when an action happens clearly.
interactions.feedback: Action hero complete! Correct tense helps everyone understand.
interactions.retryHint: Think about how a listener knows whether an action is happening now.
